newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Hamas vows Israel will pay after Hebron attack.
newsitem.headline: Hamas vows Israel will pay after Hebron attack.

text.p: The militant Islamic group Hamas said on Wednesday Israel would pay the price for its "crimes" against Palestinians after the shooting of seven Arabs by a Jewish soldier in Hebron.

"We in Hamas Movement reiterate to our people and to the entire world that the Zionists' crimes will not pass without a price sooner or later and that the comprehensive resistance to occupation will continue until occupation ends," the group said in a leaflet.
The leaflet came hours after an off-duty Israeli soldier sprayed bullets into a crowded Hebron market wounding seven Palestinian shoppers in the West Bank town.
The attack was an attempt to sabotage an imminent handover of 80 percent of the city to PLO self-rule.
Hebron, home to 400 Jewish settlers and 100,000 Arabs, is the last of seven major Palestinian cities due to come under Palestinian self-rule under a 1995 interim peace deal.

In 1994, a Jewish settler massacred 29 Palestinian worshippers in Hebron's Cave of the Patriarchs, called al-Ibrahimi mosque by Moslems. Hamas carried out a series of suicide bomb attacks against Israelis in retaliation.
Ibrahim Ghosheh, Hamas' spokesman in Jordan said that the Israeli soldier's M-16 attack on Palestinians in Hebron proved the futility of Arab-Jewish coexistence.
"The crime committed today is what Hamas has warned about... of the impossibility of co-existence between the Zionist occupation and the Palestinian people," Ghosheh told Reuters.

The leaflet said the attack reinforced the group's opposition to Israeli-PLO peace deals: "This new crime is another affirmation that the hollow agreements will not end the conflict with the Zionists."
